name: doc-product-strategy
description: Writes a Product Strategy doc with a diagnosis of the critical challenge, a guiding policy that rules things out, three to five coherent actions, a what we will not do list and the signals that show it is working. Use for "run doc-product-strategy", "write our product strategy", "everything is high priority", "we have no strategy to say no against", "strategy one-pager", "what will we not do", "turn our goals into a strategy", "check our strategy for fluff", part of the Claude Docs for Product Managers Pack by 90n.
